title: AI-Powered Insurance Claim Handling Dashboard
summary: An AI-enhanced insurance claim handling dashboard that trains fraud-detection ML models and provides an LLM-based adjuster assistant, using a synthetic claims dataset since real claim data is sensitive and unavailable. The synthetic_data_generation.ipynb notebook imports CTGAN from sdv.tabular to statistically model and expand the insurance claims dataset.
